title: Te Whare Ariki o te Karāhe Whakaata
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi whenua tawhiti o te taonga me te ataahua, e karakiatia ana te rā, kaua ko tōna Kaihanga. Ka tae mai tētahi reta me te karanga e kore e taea te wareware, ā, ka tīmata tētahi haerenga ki tētahi marae nui atu i ngā mea katoa i kitea i mua. I reira, ka hurahia te mānukanuka e tētahi papa e tinihanga ana i ngā kanohi, ā, ka huri ngā mea katoa i tētahi wā o te māramatanga.
clues: I noho ahau hei rangatira mō tētahi whenua whai rawa, ko tōna iwi i piko ki te rā, kaua ki a Allah.
I tae mai tētahi reta rangatira ki ahau, e karanga ana kia kaua ahau e whakakake i ahau anō, engari kia ngohengohe ki a Allah.
I kōrero ahau ki taku kaunihera, ā, i whiriwhiria e au te kaupapa tōrangapū i te tuatahi, mā te tuku koha hei whakamātautau i te kaituku.
I haere mai ahau ki a Sulaiman, ā, i whakakitea mai tōku torona ki ahau i roto i te āhua kē hei whakamātautau i tōku mōhio ki a ia.
I tomo ahau ki tētahi whare rangatira teitei, ā, i pohehe ahau he wai hohonu tōna papa karāhe maeneene.
I whakapuakina e māua ko Sulaimana taku tukunga iho ki a Allah, te Ariki o ngā ao.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Tuahine o Musa
Te Wahine a Abu Lahab
Te Wahine a Noa
Ko Bilqis te rangatira o Saba
Zulaikha, te wahine a Al-Aziz
identity.answer: Ko Bilqis te rangatira o Saba

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I horomia e te ika nui i te hohonutanga o te moana
I pāngia e ngā tau maha o te mate me te ngaronga o te whānau
I whakahaua kia patua he tamaiti aroha i roto i te moemoeā
I whakamatautauria e te torona huna me te whare karāhe
Ka maka ki roto i te ahi mura hei wawahi i ngā whakapakoko
trial.answer: I whakamatautauria e te torona huna me te whare karāhe

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Te Āka i hangaia i runga i te wai
Te ana piringa mō te hunga moe
Te papa o te whare kingi karaihe (Sarh)
Te awa o te Nile i te wā o te wehenga atu
Te ahi i whakaritea e ngā kaikarakia whakapakoko
location.answer: Te papa o te whare kingi karaihe (Sarh)

outcome.label: Hua
options: I horomia e te whenua me aku taonga
I noho tonu i roto i te whakaponokore, ā, i whakangaromia tahitia me tōku iwi
I tukua tahitia rāua ko Sulaimana ki a Allah, ki te Ariki o ngā ao
I toremi ki te moana i a ia e whai ana i te hunga whakapono
I hurihia hei kōhatu mō te takahi i te Hāpati
outcome.answer: I tukua tahitia rāua ko Sulaimana ki a Allah, ki te Ariki o ngā ao

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
